name: 宽松落肩套头卫衣款
description: 宽松落肩版型套头卫衣，柔软亲肤面料，罗纹加固，秋冬换季上新套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: light neutral grey studio backdrop #EDEDED for on-model and info shots, clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust shots, cobalt blue panels #4C6FBF reserved for banner and CTA moments
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft even shadows, gentle natural daylight for street scenes
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless paper studio backdrop and smooth matte pavement for outdoor scenes
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines, with oversized rotated English words used as pure graphic texture
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle for the garment, identical pose and lighting across variant panels, centered composition with generous even margins (clean white #FFFFFF stays available as a base surface even though it is not a palette swatch)
styleLock.lockText: consistent youthful seasonal streetwear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light neutral grey studio backdrop #EDEDED, cobalt blue banner panels #4C6FBF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one mustard yellow accent #E8A83E, with clean white #FFFFFF kept as the base surface for packshot and trust screens; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft even shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines with oversized rotated English words as pure graphic texture; consistent rectangular banner panels and rounded info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal editorial infographic elements; stable garment scale and centered presentation with generous even margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的主图

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow grounding the garment
shots.whitespace: clean even white margin surrounding the garment on all sides
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a pullover sweatshirt presented on an invisible ghost mannequin. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Front view at a slight 3/4 angle, eye-level, full garment visible with sleeves relaxed naturally. Bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, wrapped by a clean even white margin on all sides. 8K, commercial apparel e-commerce quality. Negative: no model, no hangers, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no floating garment.

provenance.notes: 源图为 3 张详情长图切片（男装宽松套头卫衣），按内容板块口径重记为 5：封面横幅排版、双色并排、面料区、袖口下摆特写、规格表/指数条。shot-01/02/05/06/07 直接提炼自源图版式；shot-03 场景镜与 shot-08 信任镜、shot-09 CTA 为按男装品类行业惯例的漏斗版式补全，源 FABRIC 区为空框，面料微距按同口径补全。已剥离源品牌水印、二维码、加入会员贴片、原文案与模特身份，模特仅保留角色（男性上身展示、裁切构图不含面部），产品一律以 {product} 占位，真实尺码与规格数值由商家回填。
